in_arabic.name: Musef
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Seeker of knowledge
in_arabic.long_meaning: Musef هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. One who longs to acquire knowledge and wisdom from Allah. Derived from the Arabic verb 'masaha' which means 'to seek' and 'ifta' which means 'knowledge'.

in_urdu.name: Musef
in_urdu.meaning: اسلامی نام جس کا مطلب ہے Seeker of knowledge
in_urdu.long_meaning: Musef ایک اسلامی نام ہے جو مسلم ثقافت میں گہری روحانی اہمیت رکھتا ہے۔ One who longs to acquire knowledge and wisdom from Allah. Derived from the Arabic verb 'masaha' which means 'to seek' and 'ifta' which means 'knowledge'.

in_hindi.name: Musef
in_hindi.meaning: इस्लामी नाम जिसका अर्थ है Seeker of knowledge
in_hindi.long_meaning: Musef एक इस्लामी नाम है जो मुस्लिम संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। One who longs to acquire knowledge and wisdom from Allah. Derived from the Arabic verb 'masaha' which means 'to seek' and 'ifta' which means 'knowledge'.
